tagline: We make a number for every game. We bet the ones where the market's wrong.

games.take: Two 6-1 teams, the league's No. 1 scoring offense (Buffalo, 33.3 points a game) against the No. 1 scoring defense (Minnesota, 13.3 allowed). The Vikings have allowed just 4 passing touchdowns all season, own the best red-zone defense, and blitz more than any team in the league — Allen has 3 touchdowns and 3 interceptions against the blitz this year. But Minnesota starts backup Carson Wentz with Kyler Murray out (hamstring), and Jauan Jennings is out too, while Buffalo's left tackle Dion Dawkins (ribs) is questionable. The market has this priced about right — no US price clears our 0.75% bar — so this is a lean, not a board play. No true edge, but the lean is Minnesota +3: the defense keeps it close at home in primetime, and the Vikings have forced a takeaway in every game.
games.title: Bills at Vikings: the No. 1 offense meets the No. 1 defense
games.verdict: LEAN: MIN +3 — no true edge, but the home dog with the league's best defense.

games.take: The Lakers are on the second night of a back-to-back after beating Detroit 121-116 on Sunday, and they do it without Luka Doncic, out with lower-back tightness. Atlanta has rest and a home offense that has put up 123.3 points a game at State Farm Arena. The market is tight — the only price beating our fair is an offshore Hawks -108, not a board play at a US book — so this is a lean, not a board play. No true edge at US prices, but the lean is Atlanta: rested, at home, against a short-handed Lakers team on no rest.
games.title: Lakers at Hawks: Doncic out, Lakers on a back-to-back
games.verdict: LEAN: ATL -1.5 — no true edge at US prices, but the spot favors the rested home side.

games.take: Charlotte has lost five straight and is missing Brandon Miller (groin), Kon Knueppel (hamstring, out roughly four weeks), Dennis Schroder and Grant Williams. Cleveland is the rightful big favorite, but 8.5 is a lot of points to lay on the road, and the fair spread is a coin flip. No price clears our bar, so this is a lean, not a board play. No true edge, but the lean is Charlotte +8.5 getting more than the market's own fair number suggests.
games.title: Cavaliers at Hornets: Charlotte is running on fumes
games.verdict: LEAN: CHA +8.5 — no true edge, but the points are the value side.

games.take: Toronto is without Kawhi Leonard (knee), and Scottie Barnes and Immanuel Quickley are both questionable after sitting out Friday's win at Milwaukee. Memphis (6-3) is the healthier side and the fair spread is a coin flip at 3. No price clears our bar, so this is a lean, not a board play. No true edge, but the lean is Memphis +3: the healthier team getting points against a Raptors side that may be down three starters.
games.title: Grizzlies at Raptors: Toronto's injury report decides it
games.verdict: LEAN: MEM +3 — no true edge, but the injury report points to the dog.

games.take: Houston (7-3) hosts a Denver team that flew in after travel delays out of Mexico City with six rotation players questionable — Nikola Jokic (elbow), Jamal Murray (shin) and Christian Braun (calf, illness) among them. The Rockets are thin at center themselves with Steven Adams and Clint Capela out, but the fair line has Houston winning this three times in four. No price clears our bar — the only beating number is an offshore Rockets -294 — so this is a lean, not a board play. No true edge, but the lean is Houston -9 while Denver's injury list is this long; if Jokic is cleared, the number is fair and there is nothing here.
games.title: Nuggets at Rockets: Denver's questionable list is six deep
games.verdict: LEAN: HOU -9 — no true edge, but the lean is Houston while Denver's injury list is this long.

games.take: The board play. San Antonio brings an eight-game win streak to Phoenix behind Victor Wembanyama — 29.1 points, 12.0 rebounds and a league-best 3.9 blocks a game, coming off a 52-point, 24-rebound night against Dallas. The Suns have no answer inside with Mark Williams out after shoulder surgery, leaving Khaman Maluach and Oso Ighodaro to share the center minutes. BetRivers is still hanging -315 while Pinnacle is -370 and FanDuel/DraftKings are -350/-359 — fair 77.4% vs 75.9% implied, +2.0% EV. The lean is San Antonio, and it is on the board.
games.title: Spurs at Suns: Wembanyama vs a team with no center
games.verdict: LEAN: SAS — on the board at -315 (BetRivers), +2.0% EV vs the devigged Pinnacle fair.

games.matchup: New Orleans Pelicans @ Golden State Warriors
games.take: Golden State is the rightful big favorite at home, but 9.5 is a big number and the fair spread actually tilts toward New Orleans (51.8%). The Pelicans are without center Yves Missi (knee), which hurts, but the Warriors have to win by double digits to cover. No price clears our bar, so this is a lean, not a board play. No true edge, but the lean is New Orleans +9.5 getting the better side of the fair spread.
games.title: Pelicans at Warriors: 9.5 is a lot of points
games.verdict: LEAN: NOP +9.5 — no true edge, but the fair spread tilts to the dog.
